description: Horaires théoriques des transports Aleop car et bateau is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Aléop. Arrêts des lignes de transports: ALEOP (transport régional en Pays de la Loire) Détail des spécifications: Les flux Aléop sont issus des données de travail de la Direction des transports de la Région des Pays de la Loire. Le fichier stop contient un champ additionnel qui donne le nom de la commune de l’arrêt. Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are ALEOP, YEU. The portal shows 6 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
